propositions: HTTPS requests to /review/, /opcert/, and Gerrit location / can receive Location headers with http:// scheme, downgrading the connection to plaintext
review-bot and opcert services do not trust X-Forwarded-Proto because FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS is unset, causing uvicorn to build http:// absolute URLs from the request scope
proxy_redirect rules to rewrite http:// to https:// in Location response headers are missing on the three surfaces, present only on /mcp/
The fix requires per-location proxy_redirect directives (restating default first to preserve /review/ prefix-stripping) and setting FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS='*' on review-bot and opcert services
